description: Carte Hydrogéologique is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SPW ARNE. La carte hydrogéologique de Wallone synthétise les informations hydrogéologiques disponibles à l'échelle régionale. Son objectif principal est de fournir des informations concernant l' extension, la géométrie, la piézométrie ainsi que les caractéristiques hydrochimiques et hydrodynamiques des aquifères. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are eau. The portal shows 119 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
